ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is the “schematic diagram of the topographic profile along the Xining to Lhasa line”; the vertical axis is labeled elevation (meters), the left end of the profile line is labeled “Lhasa”, and the right end is labeled “Xining”. On the profile line, the positions of rivers such as the Nujiang, Lancangjiang, Yangtze River, and Yellow River are marked in order; the overall elevation is relatively high, showing the terrain characteristics of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau area. Reasoning: From the place names in the figure, such as Lhasa—Xining and the source areas of the Nujiang, Lancangjiang, Yangtze River, and Yellow River, it can be judged that this region belongs to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and its surroundings. The question stem emphasizes “on the basis of the advantage of agricultural raw materials”, so an industry relying on agricultural and animal husbandry raw materials should be chosen. Animal husbandry in the Qinghai-Tibet region is relatively developed, and fiber raw materials such as wool are relatively abundant, so it is suitable to develop the textile industry, especially the wool textile industry.

method.method_draft: 先看图中地名：剖面线连接拉萨和西宁，并经过怒江、澜沧江、长江、黄河源区，判定该地区属于青藏高原及其周边。再读题干“在农业原料优势的基础上”要求选择依托农牧业原料的工业。结合青藏地区畜牧业发达、羊毛等纤维原料丰富，推出适宜发展纺织工业，尤其可表述为毛纺织工业。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是“西宁至拉萨一线地形剖面示意图”，纵轴标注海拔（米），剖面线左端标有“拉萨”，右端标有“西宁”。剖面线上依次标出怒江、澜沧江、长江、黄河等河流位置，整体海拔较高，呈现青藏高原一带的地形特征。
推理：由图中拉萨—西宁及怒江、澜沧江、长江、黄河源区等地名可判断，该地区属于青藏高原及其周边。题干强调“在农业原料优势的基础上”，应选择依托农牧业原料的工业。青藏地区畜牧业较发达，羊毛等纤维原料较丰富，因此适宜发展纺织工业，尤其是毛纺织工业。
